about_the_game:
Description

Sometime in the early 2000s

Delivery - is a game about life in harsh Russia. There are no zombies or geomagnetic disasters in the game, just the nature of our vast planet. Don't expect mercy from her, she's harsh and doesn't spare anyone. In the game, you have to make decisions that determine whether you wake up in a soft bed or not at all. This is the only way to survive until the warm days in order to gain strength in the face of new difficulties.

The basis of the game is the need to repair the aircraft, deliver cargo and solve the cause of the disappearance of the previous pilot.
